reviews.comment: Pop quizzes galore, and very homework/assignment heavy. Expect 2-3 long coding assignments per week. Lectures are utterly useless and cover maybe 50% of the content you have to know. DO NOT GET BEHIND. The class goes from "Hello world" to plotting heatmaps of 3D climate datasets in like 3 weeks. Good luck
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was meant to be fairly straightforward and easy, as the class is to be taught as if we know nothing about coding, but it seemed he didn't know about coding. His lectures were anywhere from 2-5 slides long, assignments were copies from previous semesters, and tests literally broke in the middle of taking them. No partial credit either.

Dr. Xu is very knowledgeable about climatology. You can tell he really cares about his students because he is always very open to feedback about the class. However, the lectures can be confusing at times due to the complicated graphs. I would recommend skimming over the chapter ahead of time to be able to understand the lectures better.
